title: Vertical Compression of a Semicircle Graph
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Give an equation for the graph of y = sqrt(4 - x^2) after it is compressed vertically by a factor of 3.

steps.title: Recall the Vertical Compression Rule
steps.explanation: Compressing a graph vertically by a factor of c > 1 divides the output f(x) by c.
steps.why: Vertical compression by factor c multiplies every y-coordinate by 1/c.

steps.title: Multiply the Function by 1/3
steps.explanation: Multiplying sqrt(4 - x^2) by 1/3 yields y = (1/3)*sqrt(4 - x^2).
steps.why: Direct application of vertical compression with c = 3.

steps.title: Interpret the Compressed Domain and Range
steps.explanation: The domain remains [-2, 2], while the maximum height at x = 0 is compressed from 2 to 2/3, forming an upper semi-ellipse.
steps.why: Vertical scaling leaves the domain [-2, 2] unchanged and scales the range [0, 2] by 1/3 to [0, 2/3].
